## Purpose and Entry Points
Velociraptor is a Go-based endpoint visibility, digital forensics, and collection platform. Operators define VQL artifacts; endpoint clients execute them and return structured results, logs, and uploads to a server. The primary binary entry point is `bin/main.go`; CLI subcommands cover frontend/server, client, GUI, offline collection, query, packaging, and administration (`bin/frontend.go`, `bin/client.go`, `bin/gui.go`). The GUI startup mode provisions a local frontend and client.

## Runtime Topology and Transport
A frontend server enrolls and communicates with distributed endpoint clients over HTTP/WebSocket transport, with cryptographic message handling separating client and server concerns. Server startup and endpoint-facing comms are rooted in `server/startup.go`, `server/comms.go`, and `server/websocket.go`. Client-side execution responds to server-issued work through `responder/responder.go` and `responder/flow_manager.go`; transport plumbing is in `http_comms/comms.go` and `http_comms/service.go`. TLS/keys and encrypted job/message transport are implemented under `crypto/client/client.go`, `crypto/server/manager.go`, and `crypto/transport.go`.

## VQL Execution and Endpoint Access
VQL is the execution language used by artifacts, interactive queries, and server automation. Plugin registration and scope construction are centered on `vql/vql.go`, `vql/scope.go`, and `vql_plugins/plugins.go`. VQL crosses a controlled filesystem abstraction boundary through accessors: the manager and path specifications are in `accessors/manager.go` and `accessors/pathspec.go`; implementations support local files, forensic images/filesystems, archives, registry data, process memory, S3, SSH, and SMB (for example `accessors/ntfs/ntfs_accessor.go`, `accessors/s3/s3.go`, `accessors/zip/zip.go`). OS-specific VQL capabilities live beneath `vql/linux`, `vql/windows`, and `vql/darwin`.

## Artifact Repository and Flow Compilation
Artifacts are YAML-defined collection/remediation/monitoring units, including a large built-in catalog under `artifacts/definitions/`. Artifact protobuf contracts are in `artifacts/proto/artifact.proto`. The repository service loads, indexes, validates, and exposes artifact metadata (`services/repository/manager.go`, `services/repository/plugin.go`). The launcher resolves dependencies, parameters, ACLs, preconditions, and compiles artifacts into client or server flows (`services/launcher/launcher.go`, `services/launcher/compiler.go`, `services/launcher/flows.go`). This is the main boundary between declarative artifact definitions and executable VQL work.

## Collection, Scheduling, and Result Lifecycle
A flow represents a collection request and its execution context. On clients, the executor manages pools, startup, resource controls, progress, transactions, and flow execution (`executor/executor.go`, `executor/flows.go`, `executor/throttler/throttler.go`). Client flow orchestration and monitoring semantics are in `flows/client_flow_runner.go` and `flows/monitoring.go`. The server dispatches recurring or multi-endpoint hunts through `services/hunt_dispatcher/hunt_dispatcher.go` and `services/hunt_dispatcher/flows.go`; client monitoring is managed by `services/client_monitoring/client_monitoring.go`. Results are persisted as simple or time-partitioned result sets (`result_sets/simple/simple.go`, `result_sets/timed/writer.go`) and can feed timelines (`timelines/supertimeline.go`).

## Persistence, Files, and Server Services
The platform abstracts metadata persistence and bulk result storage separately. Datastore implementations include file-backed, memory-cached, and remote modes (`datastore/datastore.go`, `datastore/filebased.go`, `datastore/remote.go`). The file store handles directory/memory backends, queues, compression, and sparse uploads (`file_store/api/file_store.go`, `file_store/directory/directory.go`, `uploads/client_uploader.go`). Core services manage client state, indexing, ACLs, notebooks, user/org tenancy, journaling, inventory/tools, alerts, backups, and VFS; representative roots are `services/client_info/client_info.go`, `services/indexing/index.go`, and `services/notebook/notebook.go`.

## Operator Interfaces and Integrations
The server exposes protobuf-defined gRPC and HTTP gateway APIs (`api/proto/api.proto`, `api/api.go`, `api/handlers.go`) used by the React GUI and CLI. The web UI source is `gui/velociraptor/src/App.jsx`; its API client is `gui/velociraptor/src/components/core/api-service.jsx`, and compiled assets are embedded via `gui/assets/init.go`. Authentication supports basic, certificates, OIDC, SAML, Google, GitHub, Azure, and proxy-oriented providers (`api/authenticators/router.go`, `api/authenticators/oidc.go`). Optional VQL/service integrations include S3/MinIO, GCS, Elastic, Splunk, LogScale, Azure Monitor, SMTP, TheHive, and Prometheus metrics (`vql/tools/s3_upload.go`, `vql/server/elastic.go`, `server/metrics.go`). Docker deployment is defined in `Docker/Dockerfile` and `Docker/compose.yaml`.
